title: Tower SP, The
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Funds, population, star rating
SimTower on the GBA: build a skyscraper floor by floor, keep tenants happy, earn rent
Power and money limit how much you can place; low power blocks new items

Offices, condos, hotels, restaurants, shops
Rules from the game's own messages: the Lobby goes on the 1st floor; offices placed side by side; an elevator can span at most 20 floors
The Cathedral can only go on the top floor (and only high enough: 31F/41F limits appear in the rules)
Parking ramps and elevators can be extended or contracted floor by floor

rows: use "Repair Car" in the Information screen when one malfunctions

widgets.text: Long elevator waits make tenants leave: add cars and express elevators as the tower grows

rows: scroll up and down the floors; the information screen shows each facility's status

widgets.text: Lessons (tutorial) teach placing each facility type

rows: lobby, offices, condos, hotel rooms, restaurants, shops, parking, elevators, stairs, and the Cathedral at the very top

widgets.text:
Unlocked facilities per star
New facility types unlock as the tower's star rating rises

Star rating toward the Tower rank
Star rating 1 to 5, then the Tower rank once the Cathedral is built and a wedding is held
